name: Single Leg Dumbbell Side Bridge
how_to:
Starting Position:
- Lie on your side. Place your forearm on the floor with the elbow directly under the shoulder.
- Keep your bottom-side shoulder “packed” (stable), neck neutral, and ribs controlled.
- Position your legs exactly as shown:
  - One leg stays straight with the foot on the floor (this is your support leg).
  - The other leg is bent at the knee and lifted, not resting on the ground.
- Hold a dumbbell close against your side/hip with the top hand.
Build the Support Pillar:
- Press the support foot into the floor.
- Press the forearm into the ground.
- Lift your hips so your body forms a strong line from support foot → hips → shoulder.
Stabilize and Lock In Alignment:
- Keep the pelvis stacked and level—do not let the hips roll forward or backward.
- Maintain tension through the side of the core to resist lateral bending.
- Keep the dumbbell tight to the body to reduce unwanted rotation.
Hold and Breathe:
- Breathe slowly without losing position.
- Keep the supporting shoulder stable and avoid shrugging.
Switch Sides:
- Lower with control.
- Repeat on the opposite side.
